messages:
maya: Heads-up — product asked for per-customer-tier routing + automatic fallback to model variants. Need API + console UX decisions. Current questions:
1) API shape (policy object vs separate endpoints)
2) Where to enforce quotas & fallback (edge router vs control plane)
3) Telemetry to show in console (per-tier failover counts, token cost delta)

chris: +1. I'd prefer a single policy object we can attach to org. Example idea:
```
{
  "policies": [
    {"tier": "free","regions": [
      {"id": "us-east-1", "preferred": ["rw-small"], "fallback": ["rw-tiny"] }
    ], "quota": {"daily_tokens": 10000} }
  ]
}
```
We can derive routing rules from that.

oliver: Edge enforcement for latency-sensitive fallback makes sense — do the quick check at edge and then async fallback decision from control plane if capacity low. Edge should always have a local cached policy.

rachel: UX: console needs a "policy preview" that simulates a request and shows chosen model and estimated cost. Also show historical fallback rate per-tier.

maya: Question about precedence: should org-level policy be overridden by project-level? Product wants project overrides for enterprise customers.

chris: Yes, precedence order: project > org > default. But admin toggle to lock org-level for security.

sre-oncall: Enforcement note: if we enforce quotas at edge and edge is compromised (stale policy), we might over-accept. We need a periodic policy TTL and circuit-breaker. Also logging hooks for token accounting.

infra-bot: deploy:policy-service succeeded for canary env — 1755001250 :rocket:

maya: Telemetry fields proposed: tier, project_id, region, model_selected, fallback_used(boolean), tokens_consumed, latency_ms, cost_estimate. Need to confirm retention window for per-request logs.

console-ux: For the editor, show a simple toggled view: "Basic" with presets for free/pro/enterprise and "Advanced" JSON editor. Presets should be opinionated (e.g., free -> prefer smallest conservative model + hard quota).

chris: API versioning: add /v2/policies with ETag support. When edge pulls policy, it uses If-None-Match to avoid reloads. Fallback decisions can be signaled with small delta tokens to avoid state drift.

maya: OK will draft a spec and tabletop next Tue. add any other blockers here. :thumbsup:
